violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Have all food service employees obtain CFM certification. EHS will follow up within 10 days.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: various condiments in squeeze bottles around cook area.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc PIC will label all secondary containers with food name.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE NOT OPERATIONAL.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPAIR HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE, ALL SOILED DISHWARE/EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS MUST BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP IN 10 DAYS FOR REPAIR.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no soap at bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Manager will provide soap at bar hand sink.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP salmon thawing in #5 with packaging in tact.
violations.corrective_action: Manager will discuss with staff that ROP fish packaging must be cut open or removed from packaging before thawing.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: hot water sanitizing dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. The hot water sanitizing dish machine is currently out of service and is not being used. Establishment plans to purchase and install replacement machine. EHS discussed with management that dish machine make and model are to be sent to EHS for approval before purchasing. Management is responsible for submitting HAMEND in PLUS and acquiring permits for work from plumbing/electrical/building
